origins.section: A Record Extends Only java.lang.Record, and Nothing Extends It
A Record's Only Instance State Is Its Header
A Framework That Builds an Object Empty, Then Fills It, Can't Build a Record
Keep a Class for Identity, Changing State, or Many Optional Parts

recorded.prompt:q-payment-base: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-payment-base: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-payment-base: The page says 'A record has no extends clause: its superclass is always java.lang.Record', shows javac's '{' expected error on 'extends Audited', and says to turn Audited into an interface whose method the createdAtMillis component implements.
recorded.prompt:q-route-cache: the page and the question, and nothing else

recorded.outcome:q-route-cache: In the Bill example, a static cache makes B-2 print B-1's 1250, because 'A static field belongs to the class, so the first bill's total became every bill's.'
recorded.prompt:q-orm-account: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-orm-account: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-orm-account: In the Customer example, the no-arg constructor builds the record, then name.set throws 'Can not set final ... field', and the page says setAccessible(true) does not let reflection write a record's final field.
recorded.prompt:q-guests: the page and the question, and nothing else

recorded.outcome:q-guests: The Visitor example has two different people with the same data, prints 'south added: false, visitors inside: 1', and the page explains that a record's equals compares components.

recorded.prompt:q-payment-base:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-payment-base:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-payment-base:b: The page blames the error on the record's header having no extends clause, not on the base class's fields, so no record can inherit fields from a class.
recorded.prompt:q-payment-base:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-payment-base:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-payment-base:c: The page shows 'modifier abstract not allowed here' for an abstract record and 'cannot inherit from final Invoice', so a record can't be abstract and can't be extended.
recorded.prompt:q-payment-base:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-payment-base:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-payment-base:d: The page never mentions sealed classes, but it says a record's superclass is 'always java.lang.Record', which rules out extending any class, sealed or not.

recorded.pass:q-route-cache:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-route-cache:b: The page puts the shared value down to the static field belonging to the class, not to any caching by generated accessors.

recorded.outcome:q-route-cache:c: The page states 'A static field belongs to the class', so there is one copy for all instances, not one per instance.
